'''Cerist''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]] in a [[Mirror World]].
== History ==
Cerist was captured by the [[Children of the Light]], and was later rescued by [[Elayna]] Sedai.<ref name="videogame">''[[The Wheel of Time (video game)|The Wheel of Time]]''</ref>
